findings.note: Bears team preview: Caleb Williams has thrown for 300+ yards with no interceptions in back-to-back starts, Chicago leads the NFL in rushing at 154.3 yards per game, and Seattle gets RBs Charbonnet and Price back. It also says Simmons, Sweat and Edwards strengthen Chicago's defense.

Seattle's final injury report has LT Charles Cross, WR Rashid Shaheed and RB Velus Jones Jr. out and OLB Nwosu doubtful. Chicago lists only RB Monangai as out, which fits a less explosive Seattle offense.

CBS/SportsLine lists Seattle -3 with a total of 46.5, the same as the bet's line. The page says its model has an over/under pick, but the retrieved snippet doesn't show which side, and it notes Bears TE Cole Kmet is out for the season.
